description:
1. Avoid using user-controlled input directly in `res.cookie()`.
2. Use a secure session management library (e.g., express-session with secure options).
3. If cookie values must be user-controlled, implement an allow-list of valid values.
4. Ensure cookies are set with secure flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite).
